title: [finding] The vendored Console bundles TWO zod instances (4.4.3 + the spec's 4.6.1), so spec-derived Studio schemas crash — the New Package dialog cannot create a package; dashboard/report inspectors show "Spec schema unavailable"
body:
Filing gate: **① a reproducible product defect with a named landing site** — `apps/console/vite.config.ts` + `scripts/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.ts` (the spec-dist injection) and `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/*-schema.ts`. `reach:` the Console a stock `objectstack dev --ui` serves, reproduced in a browser on fresh boots (runner + independent verifier); **release-relevant** — the published `@objectstack/console@17.5.0` carries the same split (static evidence). Reader: triage first touch, then the lane owning the console build; the framework half (pin + build script) rides the pin bump that lands the fix. Dedupe: semantic search "zod two versions console bundle toJSONSchema deferred push package schema missing from schema" here and "console zod version mismatch spec dist injection build-console toJSONSchema studio schema form" in objectstack-ai/objectstack (open + closed) → 26 hits, none this defect. QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#21056 · studio-authoring.first-run-loop · acceptance[0] ## What happens At objectui pin `db11afd4967c`, built by the framework's `scripts/build-console.sh`: - Studio → "New package (writable base)" renders only `#mdf-version` and `#mdf-type`, with "Field name / id / namespace / description declared in form layout but missing from schema. Skipping."; "Create package" stays disabled and no `POST /api/v1/packages` is sent. The server door works (`POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{…}}` → 201) — the defect is client-only. - Browser console: `[package-schema] failed to derive manifest JSONSchema from spec TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')`, stack through `vendor-zod-*.js` → `_zod.processJSONSchema` in `vendor-objectstack-*.js`. - Same class: Studio `?surface=dashboard:…` and `report:…` log `[dashboard-schema]` / `[report-schema] failed to derive …` and the inspector shows "Spec schema unavailable — basic properties only"; `page:…` logs the failure too. The package Edit/View dialogs share the same `getPackageSchema` memo. ## Reproduction 1. Framework `objectstack-ai/objectstack@ef1ed17f`, `.objectui-sha` `db11afd4967c`, `pnpm objectui:build`; `OS_PORT=

pnpm -C examples/app-showcase exec objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p

-d file:.db`. 2. Sign in as admin → `/_console/studio` → "New package (writable base)". Observe the dialog and console warning above. 3. Node-level: zod 4.4.3 `z.toJSONSchema(...)` over the spec's ManifestSchema, DashboardSchema, PageSchema, ReportSchema, ViewSchema and ListColumnSchema (built with 4.6.1) throws the same TypeError for all six; zod 4.6.1 succeeds on all six. ## Mechanism - Two copies are bundled: `vendor-zod-*.js` is zod `4.4.3` (the pin's lockfile; its toJSONSchema context has no `deferred`), `vendor-objectstack-*.js` carries zod `4.6.1` (the framework spec's own dependency; its record processor calls `ctx.deferred.push`). - `build-console.sh` exports `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`; `apps/console/vite.config.ts` → `resolveSpecDistInjection` (`scripts/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.ts`) aliases the spec and lets it keep its own zod; `resolve.dedupe` covers only `react`, `react-dom`, `sonner`. - `package-schema.ts` `getPackageSchema()` calls objectui's `z.toJSONSchema(ManifestSchema, …)` on a schema built by the other copy → throws → caught → `undefined` → `SchemaForm` falls back to `inferSchemaFromValue` → `PackageFormDialog` `canSubmit` (needs `name` + `id`) stays false. - objectui's own e2e never sets `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`, so it never sees the split; the checklist's cited pin (`e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts`) targets testids that no longer exist at the pin. ## Release relevance The framework's `release` script and `release.yml` ("Build vendored @objectstack/console SPA") run the same `build-console.sh`, cached on `.objectui-sha` + the script only (the spec's zod version is not in the key). The published `@objectstack/console@17.5.0` has a byte-identical `vendor-zod` (4.4.3), a `vendor-objectstack` with 4.6.1's `deferred`, and the `[package-schema]` warning string — static evidence; not driven in a browser. ## Landing site and acceptance - Durable fix: one zod instance in the console bundle (dedupe/alias zod for the injected spec) or a build-time assertion that the bundled zod versions match; the metadata-admin schema modules should derive JSON Schema with the zod that built the schema. - Framework half (objectstack-ai/objectstack): a zod-parity guard in `scripts/build-console.sh`, and the pin bump. objectui HEAD `582edef1c` locks zod `4.6.5`, whose `toJSONSchema` over the six 4.6.1-built schemas passes in node — a plausible mitigation, **browser-UNVERIFIED**, and still two copies that merely happen to agree. - Done when the Studio New Package dialog renders Name / Id / Namespace and creates a package on a console built by `build-console.sh`, the dashboard/report inspectors show the spec schema, and `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` acceptance[0] re-runs green. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
